messages:
amy: Heads-up — new customer (Acme) reports SSO failing after IdP metadata refresh. Error from our logs: "SAML validation failed: unsupported signature algorithm: sha1". Customer says IdP rotated keys and metadata is now signed with SHA1. Repro steps they gave below and I can attach our assertion logs.

jones_acme: Confirmed on our side — users get a 403 when IdP redirects back. Metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml. We did a key rotation earlier today.

maria_support: Thanks. Can you paste the exact stack/log lines from our SP when it rejects the metadata?

amy: Log snippet: 
```
2025-04-02T17:10:15Z ERROR saml.metadata - validation error for https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml: UnsupportedSignatureAlgorithm: http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1
2025-04-02T17:10:15Z WARN  saml.auth - rejecting metadata signed with legacy algorithm
```

triage-bot: Auto-tagged #sso #security: signature-algo-untrusted :rotating_light:

sadiq: Quick check — looks like metadata SignatureMethod uses RSA-SHA1. We rolled out a policy to reject SHA1-signed metadata (see security note from 2025-01). Repro using curl: 
```
curl -sS https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath 'string(//SignatureMethod/@Algorithm)' -
# returns: http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1
```

sadiq: Short-term mitigation options:
1) Customer updates IdP to sign metadata with SHA256 or remove signature and publish unsigned metadata + cert in JWKS.
2) We accept a manual metadata upload in the admin console (raw XML) and perform fingerprint pinning of the signing cert (flagged as insecure).
3) Temporary config toggle SAML_ACCEPT_LEGACY_ALGO=true (highly discouraged).

nikita: We intentionally disabled SHA1 in Jan 2025. Option 3 is unacceptable from policy. Option 2 is doable with controls: manual upload + enforce audit trail, hourly re-check, 24h expiry. We'll need a signed customer waiver.

jones_acme: We can't change IdP immediately — it's controlled by a legacy vendor. They'll take 72+ hours. Can you do option 2 for the first 48h so we can onboard users? We'll provide the waiver.

maria_support: I can send the onboarding waiver template and instructions. Also will ask for exact cert fingerprint (SHA256) so we can pin it.

amy: Action items: sadiq to implement manual metadata upload/temporary pin flow (support UI + backend enforcement), nikita to approve policy exceptions and sign off on audit wording, maria to get the waiver from Acme and collect fingerprint. I'll update customer with ETA.

sadiq: I can sketch a quick patch: accept a metadata XML upload endpoint that stores the raw file, extracts KeyDescriptor cert, computes fingerprint, and marks record as "manual_upload_pending_approval". backend changes + small UI modal to show security warning. Est: 6-8 hours dev + 2 hours QA.

nikita: Approve manual upload flow with conditions: (a) tenant admin must consent via signed doc; (b) we auto-expire the manual upload after 24h (can extend to 48h only with security team exception); (c) we log and surface the risk to CS and infra. I'm ok to approve 24h emergency lift.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging rollout for manual-metadata-upload feature at 2025-04-03T02:00Z, prod gated on security approval.

maria_support: I'll send the waiver and request the cert fingerprint. Also will open a support escalation ticket referencing this thread and set SLA to P2.

amy: Thanks all — I'll keep the customer updated and close loop once manual upload is live.

jones_acme: Appreciate it. We'll push the vendor to update to SHA256 but need the bridge right now.
